title: A Perfect Murder
description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: Fatal Attraction
description: A New York lawyer (Michael Douglas) with a wife (Anne Archer) and daughter sleeps with a client (Glenn Close) whose lust turns to hate.

title: Double Jeopardy
description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
description: Two cyborgs from the future battle over the life of a teen (Edward Furlong) who will someday lead humanity against the machines.

title: What Women Want
description: A freak accident gives a Chicago advertising executive (Mel Gibson) the ability to read women's minds.

title: Sabrina
description: Sons (Harrison Ford, Greg Kinnear) of a Long Island tycoon become romantic rivals for the chauffeur's daughter (Julia Ormond).

title: The Brothers Grimm
description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

title: The King's Speech
description: An extraordinary friendship forms between England's King George VI (Colin Firth) and the Australian actor/speech therapist (Geoffrey Rush) who helps him overcome a stammer.

title: The English Patient
description: A Hungarian count's (Ralph Fiennes) fling with a British newlywed leads to tragedy in World War II North Africa.

title: The Core
description: In order to save mankind, scientists and astronauts must set off a nuclear device at the center of the Earth.

title: The Bodyguard
description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.

title: Big Night
description: Two Italian brothers hope to save their failing restaurant by preparing a feast for bandleader Louis Prima.

title: Galaxy Quest
description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

title: Jackass: The Movie
description: Nitwits (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Chris Pontius) perform outrageous stunts and pull practical jokes on an unsuspecting public.

title: Welcome to Sarajevo
description: A British war reporter (Stephen Dillane) becomes obsessed with an orphanage near the front lines in 1992.

title: The Doors
description: UCLA film student Jim Morrison (Val Kilmer) finds a girlfriend (Meg Ryan), forms a band and turns tragic 1960s rock star.

title: The Perfect Score
description: High-school students (Erika Christensen, Chris Evans, Bryan Greenberg) conspire to steal the answers to their upcoming SATs.

title: The School of Rock
description: Fired from his group and desperate for money, a guitarist (Jack Black) poses as a teacher for students who play in a school band.

title: The Stepford Wives
description: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality.

title: Mimic
description: Married scientists (Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam) battle killer cockroaches that develop the ability to assume human form.

title: Paranormal Activity
description: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

title: The Lovely Bones
description: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: Marathon Man
description: The CIA and a Nazi death-camp dentist (Laurence Olivier) chase a New York graduate student (Dustin Hoffman).

title: The Untouchables
description: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force.

title: Match Point
description: A one-time tennis professional (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) becomes obsessed with his brother-in-law's (Matthew Goode) seductive fiancée (Scarlett Johansson).

title: The Crow
description: A black bird resurrects a rock musician who then avenges his own murder and his fiancée's.

title: The Haunting
description: A parapsychologist and three others stay in a house reputed to be the site of many awful tragedies and paranormal events.

title: King Kong
description: An oil explorer (Charles Grodin), a zoologist (Jeff Bridges) and a shipwrecked blonde (Jessica Lange) capture a huge ape leading to a battle atop the World Trade Center.

title: Disturbia
description: Under house arrest, a troubled youth (Shia LaBeouf) is unsure if his neighbor (David Morse) is really a serial killer or if his suspicions are the result of a captive and overactive imagination.

title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
description: Frank (Leslie Nielsen) and Ed (George Kennedy) of "Police Squad" blunder through another case, an energy-related plot in Washington, D.C.

title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
description: The fascist U.S. president enlists a jailed war hero (Kurt Russell) to retrieve a top-secret device stolen by his daughter on island Los Angeles in 2013.

title: Faster
description: A veteran cop (Billy Bob Thornton) and an assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen) track an ex-convict (Dwayne Johnson) who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers.

title: Dead Man Walking
description: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.

title: No Country for Old Men
description: An aging lawman (Tommy Lee Jones) reflects on his past and laments a changing world while trying to find and protect a hunter who took the cash from a drug deal gone bad.

title: Red Eye
description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

title: Airplane!
description: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew.

title: Airplane II: The Sequel
description: The first commercial space shuttle sends loony Ted (Robert Hays) and his former girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) on a trip to the moon.

title: Road Trip
description: Friends (Seann William Scott, Breckin Meyer, D.J. Qualls) embark on a lengthy car trip to intercept an illicit videotape mistakenly mailed to one's girlfriend.

title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

title: The Prophecy II
description: A fallen angel (Christopher Walken) tries to prevent the birth of a child who will save mankind from the forces of evil.

title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
description: A London antiques dealer (Christopher Plummer) travels to New Orleans to save his estranged daughter from his nemesis, Count Dracula (Gerard Butler).
